description: Atlas de Saneamento is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O Mapa Percentual de reservatórios em operação com limpeza, higienização ou manutenção, nos meses de julho a dezembro de 2017 faz parte da publicação Atlas de Saneamento: abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário 2021 que tem como objetivo principal retratar as condições do saneamento básico no Brasil em 2017. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 412 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are Atlas de Saneamento, Saneamento básico, Abastecimento de água, reservatório, limpeza. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
